<script>
console.log('Campaign: ' + "[100% PREREQ] PTR | PROD | Desktop | 488176 - Partners Touchpoint on Privilege Club Header Menu" + ' ExpName: ' + "Experience A");

(function() {
    "use strict";
    var ubqt = {
        selector: 'body',
        init: function() {
            helpers.elementLoaded(ubqt.selector, function() {
                setTimeout(function() {
                    ubqt.variant();
                }, 2000);
                helpers.timeout();
            });
        },
        variant: function() {
            ubqt.checkConditionsFor488176();
        },
        checkConditionsFor488176: function() {
            var navbarPCContainer = document.querySelector('.header-nav-container .nav-link.mobile_pclub');
            const userIsLoggedOut = ubqt.isUserLoggedOut();
            
            if (navbarPCContainer && userIsLoggedOut) {
                navbarPCContainer.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    ubqt.fetchOffer();
                });
            }
        },
        isUserLoggedOut: function() {
            return digitalData.page.userInfo.authState === 'logged out';
        },
        fetchOffer: function() {
            adobe.target.getOffer({
                mbox: "ptr-tp-488176-mbox", 
                success: function(offers) {
                    adobe.target.applyOffer({
                        mbox: "ptr-tp-488176-mbox",
                        offer: offers
                    });
                },
                error: function(status, error) {
                    console.error(error);
                }
            });
        }
    };
    var helpers = {
        eleTimer: '',
        elementLoaded: function(ele, callback) {
            window.clearTimeout(helpers.eleTimer);
            if (document.querySelectorAll(ele).length > 0) {
                if (typeof callback === "function") {
                    callback();
                }
            } else {
                // console.log('else');
                helpers.eleTimer = window.setTimeout(function() {
                    // console.log('else re-run');
                    helpers.elementLoaded(ele, callback);
                }, 100);
            }
        },
        timeout: function() {
            setTimeout(function() {
                window.clearTimeout(helpers.eleTimer);
                // console.log('Testing Works XXX - CLEAR');
            }, 6000);
        }
    };
    ubqt.init();
})();
</script>

<script>
  console.log('Campaign: ' + "[100% PREREQ] EXP | PROD | 341754 - Combining check-in and Manage section" + ' ExpName: ' + "Experience A");
  
    (function() {
        "use strict";
        var Atarget = {
            selector: '.booking-widget',
            init() {
                const selExists = document.querySelector(this.selector);
                if (selExists) {
                    this.activate();
                } else {
                    helpers.elementLoaded(this.selector, this.init.bind(this));
                }
                helpers.timeout();
            },
            activate(){
                var mbTAB = document.querySelector('.booking-widget app-nbx-explore').shadowRoot.querySelector("#book-tab-managebooking") || document.querySelector('.booking-widget app-nbx-explore').shadowRoot.querySelector(".tab-content .accordion-item:nth-child(3) h4")
                mbTAB.addEventListener('click', function (params) {
                    adobe.target.getOffer({
                        mbox: '341754-manageBK-mbox',
                        params: {
                            "platform": digitalData.page.siteInfo.platform
                        },
                        success: (offers) => {
                            adobe.target.applyOffer({
                                mbox: '341754-manageBK-mbox',
                                offer: offers,
                            });
                        },
                        error: (status, error) => {
                        }
                    });
                }, false);
            }
            
        };
        const helpers = {
            eleTimer: '',
            elementLoaded(ele, callback) {
                window.clearTimeout(Atarget.eleTimer);
                if (document.querySelectorAll(ele).length > 0) {
                    callback();
                } else {
                    Atarget.eleTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
                        helpers.elementLoaded(ele, callback);
                    }, 100);
                }
            },
            timeout() {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.clearTimeout(Atarget.eleTimer);
                }, 6000);
            }
        };

        Atarget.init();
    })();
</script>
